probe_source:
import Lean
open Lean

/-- Dump, for every constant of the module(s) (root `pre`), its name, kind, a hash of its
type and, for a non-theorem, of its value; module path `pre.BTZ.` normalised to `M.` -/
def dump (pre : String) (imp : Name) : IO Unit := do
  initSearchPath (← findSysroot)
  let env ← importModules #[{module := imp}] {} 
  let mods := ["MaxExtension"]
  let norm (s : String) : String := s.replace (pre ++ ".BTZ.") "M."
  let mut lines : Array String := #[]
  for idx in [0:env.header.moduleNames.size] do
    let m := env.header.moduleNames[idx]!
    unless mods.any (fun x => m == (pre ++ ".BTZ." ++ x).toName) do continue
    for n in env.header.moduleData[idx]!.constNames do
      let some ci := env.find? n | continue
      let ty := hash (norm (toString ci.type))
      let (k, v) := match ci with
        | .thmInfo _ => ("thm", "-")
        | .defnInfo d => ("def", toString (hash (norm (toString d.value))))
        | .opaqueInfo d => ("opaque", toString (hash (norm (toString d.value))))
        | .axiomInfo _ => ("AXIOM", "-")
        | .inductInfo _ => ("induct", "-")
        | .ctorInfo _ => ("ctor", "-")
        | .recInfo _ => ("rec", "-")
        | .quotInfo _ => ("quot", "-")
      lines := lines.push s!"{norm (toString n)} {k} {ty} {v} {norm (toString m)}"
  lines := lines.qsort (· < ·)
  for l in lines do IO.println l

def main (args : List String) : IO Unit :=
  match args with
  | [pre, imp] => dump pre imp.toName
  | _ => throw (IO.userError "usage: pre importModule")
